|---|---|---|---|---|
| High | goals | assist_player_id | 95.7% null (45/47) | Confirm the column is still populated upstream, or mark it optional. |
| High | matches | group_letter | 100% null (16/16) | Same as above. |
| High | matches | home_penalties, away_penalties | 75% null (12/16) each | Same as above. |
| High | v_match_results | home_penalties, away_penalties | 75% null (12/16) each | Same as above. |
| Medium | matches, v_match_results | kicked_off_at | newest 2022-12-18 (1422 days ago) | Confirm the table is still being loaded. |
| Medium | tournaments | ends_on | newest 2022-12-18 (1423 days ago) | Same as above. |
| Medium | players | date_of_birth | newest 2002-01-23 (9057 days ago) | Same as above. |
| Medium | v_player_goal_totals | tournament_year | newest 2022 (1409 days ago) | Same as above. |

There is also one low-severity finding: `v_player_goal_totals.first_goal_minute` is 2.8% null (1/36).

**What this means for analysis**
- The data is structurally sound: there are no duplicates, orphaned rows or out-of-range values.
- The timeliness findings may just reflect that the data covers the 2022 tournament and has not been updated since. Check that against what you expect.
- The penalty columns are probably null because only some matches go to a shoot-out. Only you can confirm that.
- `group_letter` is empty in every row, so don't use it.
- `assist_player_id` is nearly empty, so don't use it for assist analysis.
